expires_tomorrow.title: Game Audio Collection - Access to over 300,000 music tracks and sound effects
expires_tomorrow.description: A massive, 300,000+ audio asset bundle awaits!
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Create the perfect audioscape for your next game for a price you choose with three unique asset bundle options from the pros at Audio Hero. Highlights from this gigantic library of 300,000+ commercial-ready assets include themed voice packs for a variety of ages, realistic animal sounds, and more, alongside curated genre-specific tunes! Explore a variety of genres, from Latin to jazz and everything in between. Each tier unlocks additional assets—get the raw tools you need to achieve the sound you’re looking for, and support Children's Miracle Network Hospitals with your purchase!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before July 27nd, 2027.

Take control of your future, and help support The Global FoodBanking Network!

expires_within_72h.title: The Tanith Lee Collection by DAW Books
expires_within_72h.long_description: Discover the unforgettable tales of one of science fiction and fantasy’s greatest authors in this bundle of Tanith Lee ebooks from DAW! Meet a Martian vampire desperate to evade the prying eyes of a private detective in Sabella. Follow people living on the dark side of a planet that might be about to contact another civilization in Day by Night. Explore the mysteries of a medieval-inspired world with a reluctant goddess in The Birthgrave. There are 26 books in total in this bundle from the master fantasist, so grab them all now at the price of your choice, and support BINC with your purchase!
